shortDescription: Gather information about Splunk Enterprise Security investigation types

options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path for the incident types endpoint. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to filter investigation types. Returns the investigation type with an exact name match. If not specified, returns all investigation types.
